svg.aria-label: In the real model the gates are mostly closed: open dims per token and head in layer 15
svg.text: Qwen3.5-0.8B layer 15: of each token's and each head's 256 gates, how many are open (> 0.5)
Most cells are 0: the whole head is closed this time
Now and then a cell lights up:
each head opens only 1.2 dims on average
The gates are mostly closed, opening only
for the heads and dims that need it: a sparse switch
(the whole model from chapter 9, one 18-token sentence)
